description.value: Bicycle Cafe is a full-service bike shop in Kamloops, BC, located in a region celebrated as the birthplace of aggressive Interior mountain biking. With over 20 years serving the community, they welcome all riders and bikes — from recreational tourers to competitive racers — and carry bikes, apparel, and accessories from top industry brands. A touring cyclist will find an experienced workshop team capable of handling everything from quick tune-ups to full overhauls.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides the primary evidence base. A critical address discrepancy exists: OSM records '1650 Valleyview Drive' while the website consistently shows '1012 Victoria St, Kamloops, BC V2C 2C4' across the front page and contact subpage; per Rule 12, the website address is used and the conflict is flagged. The service booking subpage explicitly lists e-bike tune-up and diagnostic services (excluding throttle e-bikes), and the shop's broad 'full service' positioning and repair menu support the urgent mechanicals staffing criterion.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM has '1650 Valleyview Drive, Kamloops, V2C 4L9' but website consistently shows '1012 Victoria St, Kamloops, BC V2C 2C4' across multiple pages — website address used per Rule 12; OSM record should be updated.
Phone number '(250) 828-2453' sourced from website only; OSM has no phone listed, so cross-confirmation against OSM is not possible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service bike shop with 20+ years in Kamloops; meets core WWC criteria as a touring cyclist support stop. OSM address should be corrected before publishing.

E-bike service.detail: Service menu lists 'E Bike Classic Tune Up' and 'E Bike Update and Diagnostic' (Bosch, Specialized, Giant, Shimano, Fazua systems only); throttle e-bikes explicitly excluded: 'We don't work on throttle e-bikes'

wow_evidence: full-service bike shop in Kamloops... over 20 years serving the community
